published_final_diagnosis.label: Pleural melanoma of unknown primary presenting with malignant pleural effusion

diagnostic_differential_from_source: Primary lung cancer with pleural invasion

source_treatment.description: Single-agent nivolumab; dual-agent immunotherapy avoided owing to preexisting interstitial lung disease

source_disposition.outcome: Rapid progression; comfort care within three months.

key_guideline_decisions.note: See docs/guideline_sources.yaml; applicability and alternative care require clinician review.

distractors: Asbestos exposure and circumferential pleural thickening strongly mimic mesothelioma.
critical_safety_points: Do not conclude mesothelioma from asbestos history and CT alone; obtain cytology and tissue with immunophenotyping.
Account for baseline interstitial lung disease when weighing immunotherapy pneumonitis risk.
